Coram:
 Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Amit Sharma
 Order
1.  This hearing has been done through hybrid mode.
CRL.M.A. 14495/2025 (exemption)
2. Allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
The application is disposed of.

3. The present application under Section 483 read with Section 528 of the BNSS seeks regular bail in case FIR No. 567/2024, under Sections 376(2)(n)/313/328 of the IPC, registered at P.S. Anand Parbat.
4. Issue notice.
5. Learned APP for the State accepts notice and seeks some time to file a status report.
Let the same be filed before the next date of hearing, with an advance copy to learned counsel for the applicant.
This is a digitally signed order.
The authenticity of the order can be re-verified from Delhi High Court Order Portal by scanning the QR code shown above.
The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 30/06/2025 at 00:06:24 6.
Issue notice to the survivor to be served through the SHO concerned for the next date of hearing.
